analysis.hypothesis: Implement two CUDA kernels (log_softmax along dim=1 and triu on last two dims) and host launchers in custom_ops.cu. Kernels must handle arbitrary strides since contract says layout supports strides. Launchers accept raw pointers, dims, strides, and cudaStream_t. For log_softmax, parallelize over outer dims (B*H*W) and reduce over C using thread-coarsening and shared memory for partial sums. For triu, parallelize over all elements and check row/col indices. Use grid-stride loops for safety. Ensure int64_t for sizes where needed. No torch dependencies.
